## Detailed Project Engineering & Performance Benchmarks

### 1. NeuroSight: On-Device Neurological Screening
- **Primary Domain**: Healthcare AI, Edge Computer Vision, In-Browser Machine Learning
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MedBotix/NeuroSight
- **Architecture Overview**:
  NeuroSight is an edge-based screening platform capable of detecting neurological and cognitive biomarkers through high-frequency eye-movement tracking directly in the web browser. To address severe clinical data privacy concerns, the system runs 100% of inference on-device using WebGL-accelerated TensorFlow.js without transmitting patient video feeds to external cloud servers.
- **Empirical Metrics & Benchmarks**:
  - Screening Accuracy: 94.0%
  - Edge Inference Latency: 47ms per frame
  - Privacy Guarantee: 100% on-device client processing (zero cloud video telemetry)
- **Key Technologies**: TensorFlow.js, React 19, FastAPI, Python, WebGL.

### 2. RESP-AI: Real-Time Pulmonary Acoustic Monitoring
- **Primary Domain**: Acoustic AI, Deep Learning, Digital Health
- **Repository**: https://github.com/MedTechHealth/RESP-AI
- **Architecture Overview**:
  RESP-AI is an end-to-end respiratory sound analysis system designed for continuous pulmonary monitoring. It processes 48 kHz uncompressed acoustic audio streams transmitted over low-latency WebSockets and routes them through a two-stage convolutional neural network (CNN) cascade for real-time wheeze, crackle, and stridor detection.
- **Empirical Metrics & Benchmarks**:
  - Diagnostic Accuracy: 97.3%
  - Audio Stream Bandwidth: 48 kHz high-fidelity acoustic stream
  - End-to-End Processing Latency: 94ms
- **Key Technologies**: Deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Flutter, Python, WebSockets, Audio DSP.

### 3. AirGuardian: Autonomous Indoor Drone for Environmental Intelligence
- **Primary Domain**: Autonomous Systems, Robotics, Embedded Sensor Fusion, SLAM
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Joel-Shibu
- **Architecture Overview**:
  AirGuardian is an autonomous aerial vehicle designed for industrial facility monitoring, hazardous gas identification, and environmental mapping. Operating in GPS-denied indoor environments, AirGuardian executes real-time 2D/3D SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping) by fusing onboard OpenCV visual odometry with multi-sensor IoT telemetry powered by an ESP32 microcontroller cluster.
- **Empirical Metrics & Benchmarks**:
  - Operational Coverage: 500 square meters (500m²)
  - Sensor Telemetry Fusion: 8 distinct environmental and inertial sensors
  - Navigation Capability: Real-time autonomous SLAM and obstacle avoidance
- **Key Technologies**: OpenCV, ESP32 (C++), Robot Operating System (ROS / ROS2), Arduino, Micro-ROS.
